set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped Topology RealInnerProductSpace ContDiff
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
definition_context: radialSmoothCutoff R is the library's smooth real radial cutoff, taking values in [0,1], equal to 1 on the closed R-ball, supported in the closed 2R-ball, with first derivative bounded by a uniform constant divided by R for R > 0.

In this Hilbert space, gradient represents the Fréchet derivative by the Riesz isometry. The C² premise gives a genuine derivative; atTop on ℕ means n tends to infinity. MemLp at 2 means a.e. strong measurability and finite squared norm integral.
The expression q * Real.log q at q = 0 has value 0. This continuous extension on nonnegative q is used for the entropy integrand, not a normalized entropy or KL divergence.
cases.statement:
example (μ : Measure E) (f : E → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hf2 : MemLp f 2 μ)
    (hgrad2 : MemLp (gradient f) 2 μ)
    (hp : Integrable (fun x => (f x)^2 * Real.log ((f x)^2)) μ) :
    let fn := fun n : ℕ => fun x : E => radialSmoothCutoff ((n:ℝ)+1) x * f x
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, (fn n x)^2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂μ)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, (fn n x)^2 * Real.log ((fn n x)^2) ∂μ)
      atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, (f x)^2 * Real.log ((f x)^2) ∂μ)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, ‖gradient (fn n) x‖^2 ∂μ)
      atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, ‖gradient f x‖^2 ∂μ))
